items.description: Even after # CyberSecMonth comes to an end, stay alert 🚨! 🎃 Cybercriminals are not taking a break and might keep on tricking you! As cyber threats continue to evolve, protection of personal data remains essential. Here are some quick cyber tricks: 🍬Not every treat is sweet - beware of phishing emails and think before your click. 👻Don’t fall for a spooky ‘Boo!' - prevent your data from being leaked. 🪄Don’t fall for the spells - verify before you trust someone and share your personal information. Stay cyber-safe this spooky season and beyond! 🧙‍♀️Don’t get tricked, learn more: https:// link.europa.eu/ywbXrQ 🧙‍♀️Listen on how to strenghten your human defences in cybersecurity: https:// link.europa.eu/pCrBbj
